name: LatentCompositeMasked
plain: Mask-driven paste. The mask is bilinearly resized to the source size and blended linearly at an offset, in place on the destination. Unlike LatentComposite it accepts negative clamped positions internally and a resize_source option.
math:
out[top:bottom,left:right] = mask·source + (1−mask)·dest
mask = interpolate(mask, source size, bilinear), repeated to batch
resize_source: source = interpolate(source, dest size, bilinear)
label: from code
